The '''RH-35 Starforged assault cannon''' was a type of portable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The RH-35 Starforged assault cannon was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Master's Shadow Pack.
